dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are primarily observed as small, asymmetrical white punctate marks (2-5 pixels) scattered sparsely between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular, elongated pentagonal spatial relationship. The three most anterior keypoints form a narrow triangle with its primary axis oriented longitudinally along the dorsal ridge.
